title: Biomimicry Reef for Brackish Water
metaDescription: Evaluating modular reef structures that oxygenate brackish water while sheltering juvenile species.
intro: We are testing modular reef geometries that mimic mangrove root flow to lift dissolved oxygen without heavy energy use.
bullets: Flow bench tests paired with digital twin simulations
Monitoring for turbidity, DO, and habitat benefits

faq.question: Is this ready for production?
faq.answer: Not yet. We are in limited field pilots to validate durability and ecological impact.

faq.question: What are the energy requirements?
faq.answer: The designs are passive; energy is only needed for sensing, which can run on solar.

title: Responsible AI Evaluation for Field Systems
metaTitle: Responsible AI for Environmental Systems | Nexus Verium
metaDescription: Evaluation protocols to keep AI assistants safe, transparent, and aligned with environmental and community goals.
intro: We are building evaluation harnesses so AI copilots used in environmental engineering stay transparent, accountable, and useful to field teams.
bullets: Risk reviews for dual-use and data sensitivity
Red-team prompts against ecological and equity harms
processSteps: Map AI roles and decision points

faq.question: Do you support on-prem models?
faq.answer: Yes. We evaluate open and closed models and can lock deployments to on-prem or VPC environments.

faq.question: Who signs off on safety?
faq.answer: Decisions stay with accountable humans. We provide evidence and tracking, not automation of authority.

title: Water Clarity Machine Learning
metaDescription: Models that predict turbidity and clarity shifts using satellite, sensor, and weather signals for wetlands and estuaries.
intro: We are testing models that forecast turbidity swings 48-96 hours ahead to pre-stage crews and equipment.
bullets: Bias checks to avoid overfitting storm cycles
processSteps: Pilot deployments with clear escalation rules

faq.question: How accurate are the forecasts?
faq.answer: Early pilots show useful directional signals; we publish confidence bounds and avoid overclaiming.

faq.question: Can this reduce costs?
faq.answer: It helps crews focus on hotspots and avoid unnecessary deployments, saving fuel and time.
